# Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (LDOCE)

> A comprehensive online dictionary and language learning platform offering English definitions, multilingual translations, and topic-based vocabulary across multiple language interfaces.

LDOCE is a leading English dictionary resource by Pearson that provides contemporary English definitions, usage examples, and learning tools. The platform supports multiple language editions including Japanese, Korean, and Spanish, making it accessible to learners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English
- LDOCE
- English dictionary
- Multilingual translations
- Word definitions
- Language learning

- Pearson Languages
- Language reference

## Core Dictionary Access

- [Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English | LDOCE](https://www.ldoceonline.com): Main homepage for LDOCE with access to dictionary entries and learning tools across all language editions
- [Japanese Edition - ロングマン現代英英辞典](https://www.ldoceonline.com/jp): Japanese language interface for LDOCE dictionary and learning resources
- [Korean Edition - 롱맨 현대 영영 사전](https://www.ldoceonline.com/ko): Korean language interface for LDOCE dictionary and learning tools
- [Latin American Spanish Edition](https://www.ldoceonline.com/es-LA): Latin American Spanish language interface for LDOCE dictionary

## Multilingual Translation Features

- [English-Spanish Translation Search](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-spanish): English-Spanish translation search suggestions and results in LDOCE
- [English-Japanese Translation Search](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-japanese): English-Japanese translation search suggestions and results in LDOCE
- [English-Korean Translation Search](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/english-korean): English-Korean translation search suggestions and results in LDOCE

## Dictionary Entries & Word Definitions

- [exclude](https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/exclude): Dictionary entry for 'exclude' with definitions, usage examples, and related terms
